messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] package 'shiny' is not available(for R version 2.15.3
parts:
We have stopped supporting R 2.x since shiny 0.10.2 (released about 8
months ago), and R 3.0.0 was released more than two years ago (and 8
newer versions of R have been released since then). I'm wondering if
there is a particular reason that you choose to stay with R 2.x (in
case you want to upgrade R, this might be helpful:
http://fedoraproject.org/wiki/EPEL).

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] package 'shiny' is not available(for R version 2.15.3
parts:
The PNG device problem usually indicates you did not have the
cairo/pango dependencies properly installed. Chances are you built R
from source. In most cases, I'd recommend you install the binary
package (again, this might be helpful:
http://fedoraproject.org/wiki/EPEL), unless you carefully read the
logs produced from ./configure (look for the entries related to cairo)
before you make && make install.

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
Web: http://yihui.name

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] package 'shiny' is not available(for R version 2.15.3
parts:
When you said you installed cairo, do you mean the R package Cairo
(http://cran.rstudio.com/web/packages/Cairo/), or the system library
cairo (http://www.cairographics.org/download/)? I meant the latter if
you try to build R from source, which is what I recommended you _not_
to do (try to install the binary package instead). If you want to
build R from source anyway, you have to install the system library
cairo, and _probably_ also pango (http://www.pango.org/). I'm not
familiar with CentOS, so I have no idea about whether you need or how
to install pango.

I'm not a Shiny Server expert, either. Please consult the
documentation: http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/ In your
case, I said you could open the JavaScript console, and take a look at
the error message there (in Chrome, Ctrl+Shift+J).

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
Web: http://yihui.name
